stories.headline: Trump lands in Shenzhen for first-ever Trump-Xi-Putin summit Thursday, plus a Putin one-on-one

key_facts.fact: Trump arrived in Shenzhen on Wednesday Nov 18 for the APEC summit ahead of trilateral talks with Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin set for Thursday Nov 19; the BBC says the three leaders meet Thursday afternoon (no exact time published) and that it is the first time the three will hold a trilateral summit.
key_facts.excerpt: It's the first time Xi, Trump and Putin will have a trilateral summit. The three leaders are due to meet tomorrow afternoon.

key_facts.fact: Xi personally greeted Trump on the tarmac at 4:43 pm local time, the first time Xi has gone to the airport to greet a visiting foreign leader since becoming president; Putin, arriving earlier, was met by Politburo Standing Committee member Cai Qi.
key_facts.excerpt: 特朗普总统在中国当地时间星期三下午4点43分抵达深圳宝安国际机场，中国领导人习近平前往机场迎接。这是习近平就任中国国家主席以来，首次到机场迎接来访的外国领导人。

key_facts.fact: A US official confirmed Trump will also hold a one-on-one meeting with Putin on Thursday, their first in-person meeting in over a year; it was not on Trump's original schedule.
key_facts.excerpt: Trump will hold a one-on-one meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin tomorrow a U.S. official confirmed, marking the two leaders' first in-person meeting in over a year.

key_facts.fact: Trump said he plans to discuss limiting nuclear weapons and ending the war in Ukraine; talks are also expected to cover the Iran war, trade and AI, though analysts expect no substantive breakthroughs.
key_facts.excerpt: On Thursday, at a first-ever trilateral, Trump said he plans to talk with Xi and Putin about limiting nuclear weapons and bringing an end to the war in Ukraine... Analysts are not expecting substantive breakthroughs

key_facts.fact: The meeting is reportedly set for the state-owned Kylin Villa in Shenzhen and framed as a roughly one-hour session on the sidelines of APEC.
key_facts.excerpt: The trilateral meeting between China, the US and Russia is reportedly set to take place at Kylin Villa in Shenzhen on Thursday... framing the roughly one-hour meeting as a working-level engagement.

key_facts.fact: Hours before the summit, the US test-fired an unarmed Minuteman III ICBM from Vandenberg just after 11 pm Pacific on Tuesday; Air Force Global Strike Command said the test was scheduled years ago. New START, the last US-Russia cap on strategic warheads, expired in February 2026 with no replacement.
key_facts.excerpt: The unarmed Minuteman III missile was launched just after 11 p.m. Pacific time on Tuesday... The only remaining agreement on long-range, highly destructive nuclear weapons expired in February 2026.

stories.headline: US strikes Iranian missile site on Qeshm after Bahrain drone attack, ending two-month lull

key_facts.fact: US fighter jets fired on a Revolutionary Guards missile launch site on Iran's Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz on Tuesday Nov 17, in response to Iran's drone attack on a US radar at Bahrain's Sheikh Isa base; Iranian media said no infrastructure was damaged.
key_facts.excerpt: A US military official... said US fighter jets fired on a Revolutionary Guards missile launch site on Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz in response to Iran's 'aggression targeting US personnel and assets.'

key_facts.fact: AP says the exchange interrupted a roughly two-month lull in fighting, with analysts warning stalled peace talks and Iran's economic pressures raise the risk of substantial escalation.
key_facts.excerpt: The attacks and counterattacks interrupted a roughly two-month lull in fighting... Analysts said stalled peace negotiations and Tehran's growing economic pressures were raising the risk of a substantial escalation.

key_facts.fact: Kuwait's army said later on Tuesday the country was under drone attack, with air defences intercepting hostile targets; IRNA reported five to six explosions on Qeshm.
key_facts.excerpt: Kuwait's army has said the Gulf country is under attack by drones while the United States and Iran traded blows... IRNA reported five to six explosions on the island on Tuesday evening.

key_facts.fact: The strikes came while Qatar and Oman held mediation talks with Iran; Qatar warned the escalation poses a 'grave danger' to chances of a US-Iran deal.
key_facts.excerpt: Qatar warned on Tuesday that the ongoing escalation in the Gulf poses a 'grave danger' to the chances of a deal between the US and Iran, as it announced a meeting with Iranian officials later in the day.

key_facts.fact: Trump said the US was taking seriously the possibility Iran could be planning a dirty-bomb attack in Washington, citing a CNN report on US intelligence; Iran called it a baseless media campaign.
key_facts.excerpt: Trump said on Tuesday the US was taking seriously the possibility that Iran could be planning an attack involving a dirty bomb in Washington, after being asked about a CNN report citing US intelligence assessments.

key_facts.fact: The crew of the Panamanian-flagged tanker Tara Gas was reported unaccounted for after a second strike north of Khasab, Oman; India's ports minister later said one Indian sailor was missing.
key_facts.excerpt: India's ports minister later said the crew had abandoned the vessel after a second attack and that one Indian sailor was missing.

stories.headline: Fed's Waller calls for a half-point December hike to 'shock people' as inflation spreads

key_facts.fact: Fed Governor Christopher Waller told CNBC on Wednesday Nov 18 that a half-point rate increase is probably necessary at the Dec. 8-9 FOMC meeting, saying the Fed 'might need to, like, shock people'.
key_facts.excerpt: a half percentage point increase in the Fed's benchmark rate is probably necessary at the Dec. 8-9 meeting... 'You might need to, like, shock people,' he said.

key_facts.fact: Waller said the Fed must reverse the three quarter-point cuts of 2025 and may need to go further; inflation is 'headed in the wrong direction, and it's spreading out'.
key_facts.excerpt: 'First of all, you've got to take back the three insurance cuts we put in last year,' Waller said... 'we may have to go above ... three hikes plus maybe some more'

key_facts.fact: On Tuesday, St. Louis Fed President Alberto Musalem suggested as many as four hikes by spring 2027, while New York Fed President John Williams said the situation does not call for dramatic action.
key_facts.excerpt: In a speech Tuesday, St. Louis Fed President Alberto Musalem suggested as many as four hikes by the spring of 2027... 'I don't think the situation calls for dramatic action,' New York Fed President John Williams said Tuesday

key_facts.fact: Futures fully price a quarter-point hike in December and another in January; the Fed raised rates in September for the first time in more than three years and held in October.
key_facts.excerpt: Futures prices are fully pricing in a quarter percentage point hike at the FOMC's December meeting. They also are anticipating another move in January

key_facts.fact: The S&P 500 fell 1% on Tuesday to 7,340.53, its lowest since July, and the Dow lost 1.6%; spot gold slipped below $3,800 an ounce as rate-hike expectations and the dollar weighed.
key_facts.excerpt: The S&P 500 fell 1% to 7,340.53, its lowest since July, and the Dow lost 1.6% to 50,759.42... Spot gold is lower... falling beneath the USD 3,800/oz level

key_facts.fact: Minutes of the October FOMC meeting are due Wednesday at 19:00 GMT (2 pm ET).

stories.headline: EU proposes €45bn Ukraine loan, repayable only after Russia pays war reparations

key_facts.fact: The European Commission on Wednesday Nov 18 proposed a new €45bn loan to Ukraine to help fill a €70bn funding gap for next year; Ukraine would only repay it after Russia pays reparations.
key_facts.excerpt: the European Commission has proposed a new 45 billion euro ($49.5bn) loan to Ukraine to help fill a 70 billion euro ($76.8bn) funding gap for next year... Ukraine would only need to repay the loan after Russia had paid reparations

key_facts.fact: Von der Leyen said €20bn would support Ukraine's budget and €25bn is earmarked for military aid; the plan goes to an extraordinary European Council on Nov 25-26.
key_facts.excerpt: The plan will be on the agenda of the extraordinary European Council meeting on 25 and 26 November... 20 billion will support the Ukrainian budget, whilst 25 billion is earmarked for military aid

key_facts.fact: EU defence commissioner Andrius Kubilius said Ukraine forecasts Russia will use about 10 million drones this year and 20 million in 2027, and that Brussels is preparing €14.4bn in 2027 procurement for drones and ammunition.
key_facts.excerpt: 'According to Ukrainian forecasts, the Russians will use around 10 million drones this year and around 20 million next year'... first procurement programmes for 2027, worth €14.4bn for drones and ammunition

key_facts.fact: Russian strikes killed at least five people, including four in Odesa where a strike hit a UNESCO-protected area of the historic centre; Ukraine's energy ministry says Russia has launched more than 1,000 attacks on energy infrastructure since September.
key_facts.excerpt: In the southern city of Odesa, at least four people were killed... one of the strikes hit a UNESCO-protected area... Russia has launched more than 1,000 attacks on energy infrastructure since September.

key_facts.fact: Ukraine said it struck two oil refineries in southern Russia on Wednesday.
key_facts.excerpt: Ukraine carried out new strikes on two oil refineries in southern Russia, officials said Wednesday

key_facts.fact: Parallel US-mediated talks with the Ukrainian delegation on ending the war are due to begin in Berlin on Thursday, covering security guarantees and a prisoner swap agreed in Abu Dhabi.
key_facts.excerpt: parallel meetings to negotiate the end of the Ukraine war were due to begin in Berlin on Thursday... The agenda is expected to address Ukrainian demands for security guarantees and the prisoner swap agreed in Abu Dhabi last week

stories.headline: FDA approves Lembaz, first drug shown to extend survival in infantile-onset Niemann-Pick type C

key_facts.fact: On Nov 17 the FDA approved Lembaz (adrabetadex) from Beren Therapeutics, the first treatment shown to help people with infantile-onset Niemann-Pick disease type C live longer; the two previously approved NPC drugs had not been shown to reduce the risk of death.
key_facts.excerpt: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration today approved Lembaz (adrabetadex) injection, the first treatment shown to help people with a severe form of Niemann-Pick disease type C (NPC) live longer.

key_facts.fact: In 36 treated patients versus a matched external control, Lembaz cut the risk of death by 55%; median survival was 8.5 years versus 4.9 years.
key_facts.excerpt: Patients treated with Lembaz had longer overall survival compared to the matched external control group, with a 55% reduction in the risk of death. The median survival time was 8.5 years for the treated group compared with 4.9 years

key_facts.fact: The drug is injected into the spinal canal every two weeks and carries a boxed warning for hearing impairment, including permanent hearing loss; NPC affects an estimated 1 in 150,000 people.
key_facts.excerpt: Lembaz carries a boxed warning for hearing impairment, including permanent hearing loss.

key_facts.fact: The cyclodextrin therapy grew out of NIH research begun in 2006; the late-phase trial missed its clinical endpoints, and approval came after a later survival analysis of infantile-onset patients.
key_facts.excerpt: While the late-phase trial had positive biomarker data, it did not meet clinical outcome measures that would allow for an FDA approval. Subsequent evaluation of survival data... showed increased survival of individuals with infantile onset disease

key_facts.fact: Beren received a Priority Review Voucher with the approval.
key_facts.excerpt: The company received a Priority Review Voucher upon this approval.

key_facts.fact: Separately on Nov 17, the FDA granted accelerated approval to GSK's Nelkarmi (neladalkib) for previously treated ALK-positive lung cancer, ahead of its Nov 27 target date; response rate was 49% after alectinib.
key_facts.excerpt: This approval comes ahead of the original FDA target action date of November 27, 2026... the confirmed overall response rate (ORR) was 49% (33/67)

stories.headline: Goldman Sachs leads $280M Series C in spend-management fintech Payhawk at $2B valuation

key_facts.fact: London-based Payhawk announced on Nov 18 a $280M all-equity Series C led by Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, valuing it at $2B and bringing total funding past $515M.
key_facts.excerpt: Payhawk today announced a $280 million Series C round led by Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, valuing the business at $2 billion and bringing total funding to more than $515 million.

key_facts.fact: The valuation doubles the $1B Payhawk reached in 2022, when it became Bulgaria's first unicorn.
key_facts.excerpt: The deal doubles the $1bn valuation Payhawk reached in 2022, when it became Bulgaria's first unicorn.

key_facts.fact: Payhawk sells company cards and software for expenses, invoices, procurement and travel; it says it turned cash-flow positive in Q3 and 77% of customers use its AI agents daily, without disclosing revenue.
key_facts.excerpt: The company said it reached positive cash flow in the third quarter and that 77% of customers use its AI agents every day. It did not disclose its revenue.

key_facts.fact: All existing investors including QED, Greenoaks, Lightspeed, Hedosophia and Bek Ventures joined; Goldman's James Hayward joins the board, and the deal remains subject to regulatory approval.
key_facts.excerpt: All existing investors, including QED, Greenoaks, Lightspeed, Hedosophia and Bek Ventures, participated in the round... The transaction remains subject to standard regulatory approvals.
